quests.name: A Student's Uniform
quests.offer: Every student of this guild wears the uniform. Tailor Nokar in the market has one put aside for you: go and fetch it, then come and show me.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Tailor Nokar.
steps.says: Lanlin's new student? This uniform is yours. Wear it well.

steps.journal: Show Student's Uniform to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: It suits you. Welcome to the guild of alchemy.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 1" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Bound to Klick'Anon
quests.offer: Before you go wandering, have Spiritmaster Savi bind your spirit, past the gatehouse near the Bridge of Amazing Impracticality. Then sign Coachman Rizkar's ledger, southwest outside the city, and report back.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Spiritmaster Savi.
steps.says: Your spirit is bound here now. Go on to the coachman.

steps.journal: Speak with Coachman Rizkar.
steps.says: Sign here. There: you're in my ledger, and my coach will carry you.

steps.journal: Speak with Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Good. Now you can always find your way home.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 2" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Bat Wings
quests.offer: The guild is running low on bat wings. Slay the bats outside the city and bring me two ruined bat wings.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Collect 2 ruined bat wings from Bats.
Bring 2 ruined bat wings to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Ruined, but they will do. Here is something to study: a hardening agent.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 3" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Supplies for Ambrakma
quests.offer: Alchemist Ambrakma, at the tables northwest of the guild, needs supplies. Go to him and do as he asks.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Chemist Ambrakma.
steps.says: Bring me a glass beaker from Samwe at the lab on Stemwater Lake, a wooden tube from Folsop by the quarry, and the chitin of an ant.

steps.journal: Speak with Merchant Swame.
steps.says: A beaker for Ambrakma? Mind you don't drop it.

steps.journal: Speak with Merchant Folsop.
steps.says: One wooden tube, as promised.

steps.journal: Collect shattered ant chitin from Ants.
Bring Glass Beaker, Wooden Tube and shattered ant chitin to Chemist Ambrakma.
steps.says: Everything I asked for. Take this shaft for your trouble.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 4" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Samwe is Merchant Swame here (the tower on Stemwater Lake, south past the coachman). Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Soft Iron Shaft". The reward is ours: Soft Iron Shaft, the item the guide names, made for this server (Made by Chemist Ambrakma for a glass beaker, a wooden tube and shattered ant chitin) (tools/seed_class_quest_rewards.py, 2026-10-30).

quests.name: The Mindwhippers
quests.offer: A new species called mindwhippers has been seen outside Klick'Anon, along the mountains to the southwest. Bring me a stunned mindwhipper.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Collect Stunned Mindwhipper from mindwhippers.
Bring Stunned Mindwhipper to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Fascinating. Learn this refinement; you have earned it.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 5" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Family Errands
quests.offer: My brother Zigbar in Kara Village, west of here, has an alchemy recipe for me. Fetch it. Then there is Blackpaw, a bear south of the city: I need his dried honey fur.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Brother Zigbar.
steps.says: For my brother? Take it, and tell him to write.

steps.journal: Bring Zigbar's Alchemy Recipe to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Zigbar's recipe at last. Now the bear.

steps.journal: Collect Dried Honey Fur from Blackpaws.
Bring Dried Honey Fur to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Sticky, but perfect. Here: a sublimation, and gloves to keep your hands clean.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 7" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). A GM may place him south of the city. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Silk Spun Gloves".

quests.name: A Note for Lyriam
quests.offer: Carry this note to Lyriam Kaelean in Fayspire and help her with whatever she asks.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Bring Lanlin's Note to Lyriam Kaelean.
steps.says: Lanlin wants an orc wizard's staff. Kill one near the Hatebone orc cave, between the hills, and bring me its staff.

steps.journal: Collect Orc Wizard's Staff from Orc Wizards.
Bring Orc Wizard's Staff to Lyriam Kaelean.
steps.says: Take this note back to Lanlin.

steps.journal: Bring Lyriam's Note to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Lyriam is pleased with you, and so am I. This staff is yours.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 10" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). No creature is named Orc Wizard here; the orc casters by the Hatebone cave south of Fayspire (orc augur L10, orc witchdoctor L10) could stand in. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Brown Gnarled Staff". The reward is ours: Brown Gnarled Staff, the item the guide names, made for this server (Given by Lanlin Ogledmaggen for Lyriam's note) (tools/seed_class_quest_rewards.py, 2026-10-30).

quests.name: Saltpeter
quests.offer: A fire goblin alchemist in the Lavastorm Mountains carries minerals I want. Get them, and take them to Goben Gernhard in Kara Village, in the northwest tower: he knows rocks.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Collect Fire Goblin Minerals from Fire Goblin Alchemists.
Bring Fire Goblin Minerals to Groben Grenard.
steps.says: A Taereg jewel thief stole my rose quartz. Get it back for me and I will tell you what this is.

steps.journal: Collect Rose Quartz from taereg jewel thieves.
Bring Rose Quartz to Groben Grenard.
steps.says: My quartz! Your mineral is saltpeter. Take Lanlin these blue salts.

steps.journal: Bring Blue Salts to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Saltpeter! Learn this quickening.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 13" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Goben Gernhard is Groben Grenard here. The guide has the player buy the blue salts; here Goben hands them over. No fire goblin of level 13 is on this server (Lavastorm's are 59-62).

quests.name: Barium
quests.offer: I need barium. Dreggen Hardtoe in Moradhim can help you find it; bring tunar.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Dreggen Hardtoe.
steps.says: Powdered atacanite first: Protector Koal has it.

steps.journal: Speak with Protector Koal.
steps.says: Slay Grizglurg and bring me his holy symbol, and the atacanite is yours.

steps.journal: Collect Grizglurg's Holy Symbol from Grizglurgs.
Bring Grizglurg's Holy Symbol to Protector Koal.
steps.says: Well done. Take the atacanite to Dreggen.

steps.journal: Bring Powdered Atacanite to Dreggen Hardtoe.
steps.says: Now the barium: it is in the caves to the south, and Eldemore must let you dig.

steps.journal: Speak with Eldemore Barkfire.
steps.says: Dig, then: here is your barium.

steps.journal: Bring Barium to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Barium, and atacanite with it. These bracers and a refinement are yours.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 15" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's mining with a pickaxe is Eldemore handing over the barium; Dreggen's price is not given and is left out. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Lanlin's Padded Bracers".

quests.name: Starfire Ore
quests.offer: Deliver this shipment to Muniel at the Tea Garden, on the second floor of the north building. Then Truborne Jaegir in Highbourne will trade what he knows of starfire ore. Bring me the ore.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Bring Shipment for Muniel to Muniel.
steps.says: Lanlin's shipment, safe and sound. Thank him for me.

steps.journal: Speak with Truborne Jaegir.
steps.says: Four glands from the giant stink bugs and I'll tell you where starfire ore is.

steps.journal: Collect 4 Stink Bug Glands from giant stink beetles.
Bring 4 Stink Bug Glands to Truborne Jaegir.
steps.says: The stoneite golems at Trail's End carry starfire ore.

steps.journal: Collect Starfire Ore from Stoneite Golems.
Bring Starfire Ore to Lanlin Ogledmaggen.
steps.says: Starfire ore! You have learned all I can teach you here.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/alchemist.json, "# Level 20" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide offers a choice of Student's Knack (with a hammer) or Klick'Anon Cocktail (with a compendium); a quest here gives no choice, so neither is given. The reward is ours: the choice of the Student's Knack or the Klik'Anon Cocktail scroll, the two level-20 paths every city's guide offers (their weapons, each city's own, left out) (tools/fill_class_quest_rewards.py, 2026-10-30).

quests.name: The Acolyte's Robe
quests.offer: Every acolyte of Brell's church wears the robe. Tailor Tavin and his brother Prenlip keep a stand by the east wall; Tavin has a robe for you. Fetch it and show me.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Tailor Tavin.
steps.says: An acolyte's robe for Teka's new student. Here you are.

steps.journal: Show acolyte's robe to Teka Harnswoof.
steps.says: Now you look like one of us. Welcome.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 1" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Bound to the Church
quests.offer: Spiritmaster Bage, just west of me, will bind your spirit. Then sign Coachman Rizkar's ledger, outside over the Bridge of Amazing Impracticality, and come back.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Spiritmaster Bage.
steps.says: Your spirit is bound here. Now go and sign the coachman's ledger.

steps.journal: Speak with Coachman Rizkar.
steps.says: Your name's in my ledger now. My coach will take you where you need to go.

steps.journal: Speak with Teka Harnswoof.
steps.says: Good. Wherever you fall, you will find your way back.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 2" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Strands of Rat Fur
quests.offer: The church needs two strands of rat fur. Slay the rats out past the coachman and bring them to me.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Collect 2 Strands of Rat Furs from Rats.
Bring 2 Strands of Rat Furs to Teka Harnswoof.
steps.says: Exactly what we needed. Learn this blessing, with Brell's thanks.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 3" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Master Micah's Mallet
quests.offer: I will make you a proper weapon if you bring me lubricating oil from Merchant Samwe at Stemwater Lake, dusting feathers from Merchant Folsop beneath the market, and two cracked ant pincers.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Merchant Swame.
steps.says: Oil for Master Micah? Here.

steps.journal: Speak with Merchant Folsop.
steps.says: Dusting feathers, as fluffy as they come.

steps.journal: Collect 2 cracked ant pincers from Ants.
Bring Lubricating Oil, Dusting Feathers and 2 cracked ant pincers to Master Micha.
steps.says: Everything. Here is your mallet; swing it in Brell's name.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 4" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The oil and feathers are bought in the guide; here the merchants hand them over. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Initiate's Mallet". The reward is ours: Initiate's Mallet, the item the guide names, made for this server (Made by Master Micha from lubricating oil, dusting feathers and a cracked ant pincer) (tools/seed_class_quest_rewards.py, 2026-10-30).

quests.name: A Live Mindwhipper
quests.offer: A new creature has been found just outside the great walls: the mindwhippers. Their hive is along the mountainside southwest of the city. Bring me a stunned mindwhipper.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Collect Stunned Mindwhipper from mindwhippers.
Bring Stunned Mindwhipper to Teka Harnswoof.
steps.says: Still twitching! Well done. Take this.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 5" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Earblowers' Gears
quests.offer: The Earblowers of Rivervale need spare parts for their windmills. Buy three small gear wheels from Merchant Samwe at Stemwater Lake, and Waysender Glowbap will send you to Rivervale. Find Zale Earblower.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Merchant Swame.
steps.says: Three small gear wheels for the Earblowers.

steps.journal: Speak with Zale Earblower.
steps.says: Take the wheels to my wife Zarene at the manor, northwest of the bridge, then bring two back to me.

steps.journal: Bring Small Gear Wheel to Zarene Earblower.
steps.says: Thank you, dear. Take the other two to Zale.

steps.journal: Bring 2 Small Gear Wheels to Zale Earblower.
steps.says: Goblin burglars stole my rumpled cap. They roam Misty Thicket, past the pickclaws. Take this spell; it will help.

steps.journal: Collect Rumpled Cap from goblin burglars.
Bring Rumpled Cap to Zale Earblower.
steps.says: My cap! Waysender Windfoot will send you home.

steps.journal: Speak with Teka Harnswoof.
steps.says: The Earblowers are grateful, and so is the church.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 7" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The gear wheels are bought in the guide; here Samwe hands them over. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Teka's Greaves".

quests.name: The Coldpaw Gnolls
quests.offer: Stily Hornbar is studying the Coldpaw gnolls in their camp west of the city; they will not harm you. Help him.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Stily Hornbar.
steps.says: I want to give the gnolls a talisman as a friendly gesture. Ask Master Micah to make one.

steps.journal: Speak with Master Micha.
steps.says: A talisman of Brell needs a punctured widow's eye, from the spiderlings south of the gates, and a holy symbol of Brell from Merchant Folsop.

steps.journal: Collect Punctured Widow's Eye from Widow Spiderlings.
Speak with Merchant Folsop.
steps.says: A holy symbol of Brell, for the church.

steps.journal: Bring Punctured Widow's Eye and Iron Holy Symbol of Brell to Master Micha.
steps.says: Here is the talisman. Take it to the gnolls.

steps.journal: Bring Talisman of Brell to Renard Coldpaw.
steps.says: Brave enough to walk in here? Prove it: bring me two bones of the Coldpaw dogs, south of your city.

steps.journal: Collect 2 Chewed Bones from Skeletal Dogs.
Bring 2 Chewed Bones to Renard Coldpaw.
steps.says: Brave indeed. Take this mace.

steps.journal: Speak with Stily Hornbar.
steps.says: Friends with the Coldpaw! My study can go on.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 10" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). A GM may place him in the Coldpaw camp west of the city. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Dogtooth Mace". The reward is ours: Dogtooth Mace, the item the guide names, made for this server (Made by Renard of the skeletal dogs' chewed-up bones) (tools/seed_class_quest_rewards.py, 2026-10-30).

quests.name: The Broken Pickers
quests.offer: The mushroom pickers are broken. Jarlo Busrobber at the mushroom farms, by the pond in the lower levels, will tell you what is wrong.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Jarlo Busrobber.
steps.says: The pickers need new control boards. The Model II PEs in the Clockwork Village carry them.

steps.journal: Collect 2 Control Boards from Model II PEs.
Bring 2 Control Boards to Jarlo Busrobber.
steps.says: They work again! Tell Master Micah.

steps.journal: Speak with Master Micha.
steps.says: Allister Flobbergrop is behind these clockworks. His assistant Psova Brinkbar is by the mine east of the city.

steps.journal: Speak with Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: The clockworks have taken Allister. Bring me two legs of the clockwork spiders, the model XXIIIs.

steps.journal: Collect 2 small spider legs from model series XXIIIs.
Bring 2 small spider legs to Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: Now Camwe Gearcrafter's magnifier: Camwe has gone rogue, south of here by a defiled druid ring.

steps.journal: Collect Magnifier from Camwe Gearcrafters.
Bring Magnifier to Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: Thank you. Tell Master Micah.

steps.journal: Speak with Master Micha.
steps.says: Well done. Learn this ward against the dead.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 13" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Deactivating the Clockworks
quests.offer: Psova Brinkbar needs you again, by the mine east of the city. Go to her as soon as you can.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: A patrol drone, XJ5, walks the Clockwork Village. Bring me its clockwork shield.

steps.journal: Collect Clockwork Shield from Patrol Droid XJ5s.
Bring Clockwork Shield to Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: Now Allister's book, the Clockworkopedia. He lies in Collonridge Cemetery: dig by his tombstone, northeast outside the Tomb of Elders.

steps.journal: Find Allister's tombstone in Collonridge Cemetery.

events.text: You dig beside Allister's tombstone and find a book: the Clockworkopedia.

steps.journal: Bring Clockworkopedia to Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: Take my plans to Zale Earblower in Rivervale.

steps.journal: Bring Psova's Plans to Zale Earblower.
steps.says: Let me look these over. Meanwhile my wife Zarene wants you.

steps.journal: Speak with Zarene Earblower.
steps.says: I want to bake a mushroom pastry. Bring me a Kithicor myconid's stalk, from the forest east through the tunnel.

steps.journal: Collect Kithicor Myconid Stalk from Kithicor myconids.
Bring Kithicor Myconid Stalk to Zarene Earblower.
steps.says: Lovely. Zale has the plans for you.

steps.journal: Speak with Zale Earblower.
steps.says: Here are Psova's plans back. Clever work.

steps.journal: Bring Psova's Plans to Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: Take these bracers. Teka will want to hear.

steps.journal: Speak with Teka Harnswoof.
steps.says: You serve Brell well. Learn this.

quests.notes: EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/klick-anon/cleric.json, "# Level 15" (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's dig at Allister's tombstone is a place to reach with a popup. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Psova's Bracers".

quests.name: Psova's Contraption
quests.offer: I cannot make Psova's contraption work. Take it to Snafitzer, in his clockwork house west of Tethelin, past the gnomish observatory.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Bring Psova's Contraption to Snafitzer.
steps.says: I need Moradhim ore to fix it. Merchant Brant in Moradhim sells it, for 640 tunar.

steps.journal: Bring 640 tunar to Merchant Brant.
steps.says: Moradhim ore, the finest. Mind the weight.

steps.journal: Bring Moradhim Ore to Snafitzer.
steps.says: I'll fix it, but do me a favor: kill Prophet Grug in the Druk and bring me his staff.

steps.journal: Collect Grug's Staff from Prophet Grugs.
Bring Grug's Staff to Snafitzer.
steps.says: Here is your contraption, working. Take it to Teka.

steps.journal: Speak with Teka Harnswoof.
steps.says: It works! Take it to Psova.

steps.journal: Bring Fixed Contraption to Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: I need a hollowed shaft. Barly Sowser in Bobble-by-Water makes them.

steps.journal: Speak with Barly Sowser.
steps.says: A hollowed shaft? First, the great Wailing Tree to the west is corrupted. Bring me a piece of its root.

steps.journal: Find a root deep in the tunnels of the Wailing Tree.

events.text: Roots twist through the wall of the chamber. You pluck one: a wailing root.

steps.journal: Bring Wailing Root to Barly Sowser.
steps.says: Here's your shaft. Mind the wailing.

steps.journal: Bring Hollowed Shaft to Psova Brinkbar.
steps.says: One last thing: Unit I in the Clockwork Village holds the control gear. Bring it to Teka.

steps.journal: Collect Control Gear from Unit Is.
Bring Control Gear to Teka Harnswoof.
steps.says: The rogue clockworks are finished. Well done.

quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Tailor Nokar.
steps.says: Temwiddle's new student? This one's yours.

steps.journal: Show Student's Uniform to Prof. Temwiddle.
steps.says: Splendid. Welcome among the enchanters.

steps.says: Your name's in my ledger.

quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Collect 2 damaged firefly wings from Fireflies.
Bring 2 damaged firefly wings to Prof. Temwiddle.
steps.says: Lovely, still glowing a little.

quests.name: Valespin's Staff
